name: dsh-codebase-memory
description: DSH host bundle: index the session workspace with codebase-memory-mcp, expose it through @njuptlzf/mcp-adapter (one ~250-token MCP proxy tool instead of 17 tool schemas), and add trigger layers — code_find/code_callers wrappers, optional grep/glob intercept, conditional runtime context, write-after staleness tracking — so symbol lookups reach the code graph without depending on how the question was phrased, with cumulative-across-restart intercept/replace counters shown as read-only cards on the settings page over a volatile channel, with six hot-editable fields (mode/tools/budget/hints/tracking/telemetry) laid out by layer with per-field reset and a read-only retrieval-layer status line, plus an out-of-session engine warm-up so the first query never pays cold-start cost, settled on its real completion (report shows pending while heating, ok with elapsed ms when done) rather than a stopwatch timeout. Two complementary retrieval layers: structure (codebase-memory graph) + optional semantic (zvec-grep) — the semantic layer has a settings-page toggle (two-step cost confirm, honest restart-pending state) and an agent-triggered install path (code_setup action=install-zg); off by default, ~430MB is never downloaded without a human nod. A live adapter-process axis (fresh/stale/no-process, reported by code_setup and the page) plus code_setup action=restart-adapter turn 'manifest rewritten but the running process never reloaded it' from a silent 0-server deadlock into a visible one-call fix — no host restart needed. Pin reconciliation: bootstrap compares the installed adapter version against the pin and reinstalls on drift (raising the pin actually ships the manifest watcher and the scriptMode opt-in, upstream #744/#34), while bootstrap=manual only records the gap. The reporting path honours its own wording: code_setup re-measures the process axis per call (30 s TTL, snapshot lines age-stamped), restart-adapter tolerates processes that legitimately died mid-kill and invalidates the snapshot before anything can throw, counters lift from the cumulative file on read, and telemetry lines carry the emitting pid.
author: njuptlzf
